x: He now looks forward to high jump training sessions at Kingsmeadow – and taking his place in our BAL track and field teams again. Tom Osment steps in … We have a new man in charge of U20 Men’s Road & Cross Country Running.
Pete had done an absolutely brilliant job and the success of the Tom Osment coached squad was added to by eighteen year-old Joe van der Toorn who took the Bs up six places.
Plans for the summer include the AAA U20 5000m and some training sessions with Tom Osment’s group which includes other outstanding young Belgravians Joe van der Toorn and Phil Wicks.
